inventory.name: Leather Armor
inventory.desc: The breastplate and shoulder protectors of this armor are made of leather that has been stiffened by being boiled in oil. The rest of the armor is made of softer and more flexible materials.

inventory.name: Iron Staff (Modded)
inventory.desc: A solid length of forged and quenched iron, balanced and counterweighted so a skilled fighter can wield it with speed and precision rather than raw strength alone. Unlike a simple wooden quarterstaff, these are typically forged by smiths who specialize in monastic or dueling weapons — the iron core resists breaking against blades, but the true danger comes from the wielder's technique, not the metal's weight. If help with two hands this weapon does 1d10 damage.

inventory.name: Iron Nunchucks (Modded)
inventory.desc: Twin iron bars joined by a short length of chain, swung and snapped between hands in rapid, unpredictable arcs. Their speed makes them hard to read, but landing a solid hit takes real training — an untrained swing is as likely to strike the wielder as the target.

inventory.name: Charkam
inventory.desc: A razor-edged ring of steel, thrown with a spinning wrist flick that keeps it stable in flight. A well-thrown chakram curves back toward a skilled wielder's hand, though catching it takes practice. If attached to another weapon this add 1d4 damage.

customFeatures.name: Fancy Footwork
customFeatures.desc: During your turn, if you make a melee attack against a creature, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn, whether you hit or miss.

customFeatures.name: Rakish Audacity
customFeatures.desc:
**Bold.** You add your Charisma modifier to your initiative rolls.

**Audacious.** You don't need advantage on the attack roll to use your Sneak Attack on a creature if no creature other than your target is within 5 feet of you. All the other rules for Sneak Attack still apply to you.
